format: Supplied trained Ultralytics checkpoint re-saved for the embedded runtime: model only, unfused, CPU float32, pickle protocol 2, legacy serialization
source: User-supplied Downloads/holocube_orientation.pt on 2026-11-15: the training notebook's copy of best.pt (new zip format, half precision, with training records)
conversion: Tools/make-orientation-deployment.py in the Quest repository (Ultralytics 8.4.56). Weights and module structure are unchanged apart from the float16 to float32 cast; the tool verifies that the deployed weights equal the supplied ones. Each legacy save has different bytes, so this committed file's hash is the one the apps check.
module_methods: Inference-only adaptation of Ultralytics 8.4.56 (Segment26 head, Proto26 prototypes) in checkpoint_runtime.py
architecture: YOLO26n-seg, end-to-end, eight classes, 32 mask prototypes
app_output_note: The five strongest rows. The triangle is taken from the mask as Ultralytics' process_mask defines it: top-left corner A, top-right corner B, bottom tip C, in model-input pixels.
class_definition: The compass direction the hologram pyramid is seen from. The mask is a triangle over the pyramid face showing that direction's cube; from the four diagonal directions, where two faces are visible, the labels marked the middle of the pyramid.

training_metrics.note: From the checkpoint's own record: Ultralytics validation split at 640 px at the best epoch (same room and rig, time-block split); not a new-scene benchmark. Train and test scores were not supplied with the checkpoint.

validation: Three test-split frames (bright North, dimmed East, dark Northwest) compared against independent Ultralytics inference under the embedded runtime versions on a desktop; not an accuracy benchmark, and not yet run on a phone or headset
known_behaviour: On some frames the end-to-end head returns two or three near-identical rows that share the confidence (seen on the test frame South_bright_665.jpg: 0.39, 0.38, 0.25); the apps keep the strongest row.

intended_dataset.source_video: Eight phone recordings (one per direction), each joining a bright, a dimmed, and a dark-room clip; 1920 x 1080; 700 frames taken evenly from each clip
intended_dataset.labels: Semi-automatic: 104 hand-marked triangles, a YOLO26n keypoint model trained on them, temporal smoothing; 48 random frames spot-checked visually; 16,141 labeled images and 659 with an empty label file; first-pass labels, weakest for the diagonal directions and in bright light
intended_dataset.note: Prepared in this project on 2026-11-15 and used to train this checkpoint in the Colab notebook.
